title: Core Scientific rises 5% as AMD strikes $14 billion AI infrastructure deal with option to reach 2.5 GW
excerpt: AMD will secure more than 500 MW of U.S. data center capacity beginning in 2027, while an expansion option could make the partnership five times larger.
content_html:
Core Scientific (NASDAQ: CORZ) and AMD (NASDAQ: AMD) announced Tuesday an AI infrastructure partnership covering more than 500 MW of U.S. data center capacity beginning in 2027. AMD can expand the arrangement to as much as 2.5 GW.

On its Q2 Earnings call, Core Scientific management estimated that the AMD contracts could generate more than $14 billion in base revenue over its duration.

The companies will collaborate on designing the physical infrastructure and rolling out AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs, with ROCm software underpinning the planned AI systems. The capacity is meant to serve customers deploying AMD products, not AMD's own computing needs.

AMD will also be issued market-priced warrants to buy Core Scientific common stock, subject to certain commercial conditions. The announcement did not say how many shares were included, the exercise price, the timing of issuance or the conditions tied to the warrants.

Initial capacity exceeds 500 MW

AMD's initial commitment represents more than one-fifth of the partnership's potential 2.5 GW scale. The larger figure is an expansion option; the companies did not say that capacity had been ordered for immediate deployment or provide a timetable for reaching it.

The agreement also lacks site-level allocations, construction costs, lease rates and revenue projections. Core Scientific and AMD described it as a strategic infrastructure relationship rather than a purchase order for a specified number of processors or accelerators.

Mathew Hein, AMD's senior vice president and chief strategy officer of corporate development, said access to powered data center capacity is needed to bring more AI compute online.

"Core Scientific's extensive portfolio of AI-ready data centers expands access to the infrastructure our customers need to deploy AMD AI solutions at scale," Hein said. "Together, we are helping model builders, cloud providers and enterprises accelerate AI adoption while strengthening the AMD ecosystem."

The companies did not identify any customers, cloud platforms or AI models expected to use the capacity. They also did not specify which versions of AMD's Instinct accelerators, EPYC server processors or ROCm platform will be deployed.

Core Scientific continues its AI infrastructure shift

Core Scientific runs purpose-built data centers for high-density colocation and still earns bitcoin through its own mining operations and hosting services. The company said the bulk of its revenue now comes from high-density colocation services, and it is repurposing the rest of its mining facilities as circumstances allow.

content_html_zh:
Core Scientific（纳斯达克股票代码：CORZ）和 AMD（纳斯达克股票代码：AMD）周二宣布建立人工智能基础设施合作伙伴关系，从 2027 年开始覆盖超过 500 兆瓦的美国数据中心容量。 AMD 可以将该安排扩大至 2.5 GW。

在其第二季度收益电话会议上，Core Scientific 管理层估计 AMD 合同在其期限内可产生超过 140 亿美元的基本收入。

两家公司将合作设计物理基础设施并推出 AMD Instinct GPU 和 EPYC CPU，并以 ROCm 软件支撑计划中的人工智能系统。 该容量旨在满足部署 AMD 产品的客户，而不是 AMD 自己的计算需求。

AMD 还将根据某些商业条件发行市场定价的认股权证来购买 Core Scientific 普通股。 该公告没有透露认股权证的数量、行权价格、发行时间或相关条件。

初始容量超过500MW

AMD 的初步承诺占该合作伙伴关系潜在 2.5 GW 规模的五分之一以上。 较大的数字是扩展选项；这些公司没有表示已下令立即部署能力，也没有提供达到目标的时间表。

该协议还缺乏场地分配、建筑成本、租赁费率和收入预测。 Core Scientific 和 AMD 将其描述为一种战略基础设施关系，而不是特定数量的处理器或加速器的采购订单。

AMD 高级副总裁兼企业发展首席战略官 Mathew Hein 表示，需要获得强大的数据中心容量，以实现更多的在线人工智能计算。

Hein 表示：“Core Scientific 广泛的 AI 就绪数据中心产品组合扩大了客户大规模部署 AMD AI 解决方案所需的基础设施的访问范围。” “我们将共同帮助模型构建者、云提供商和企业加速人工智能的采用，同时加强 AMD 生态系统。”

两家公司没有透露任何预计使用该容量的客户、云平台或人工智能模型。 他们也没有具体说明将部署哪些版本的 AMD Instinct 加速器、EPYC 服务器处理器或 ROCm 平台。

Core Scientific 继续推进人工智能基础设施转型

Core Scientific 运营着专门为高密度托管而构建的数据中心，并且仍然通过自己的挖矿业务和托管服务赚取比特币。 该公司表示，目前其大部分收入来自高密度托管服务，并且正在根据情况重新调整其余采矿设施的用途。
